    # Verify if the input lists contain non-negative integers only
    if any(num < 0 for num in game) or any(num < 0 for num in guess):
        raise ValueError("Input lists must contain non-negative integers only")

    # Calculate the deviations for each prediction
    deviations = [abs(game[i] - guess[i]) if game[i] != guess[i] else 0 for i in range(len(game))]

    return deviations
